reviews.review:
The game is incomplete. 
Only one actual cutscene at the end of the DLC. None in the base-game unless you include the still shot at the beginning.
Customization and gameplay shooting is fun. There's plenty of weapons, outfits, attachments, and classes. 
Challenge cards can add a little variety to the missions, although, the weapon jam one is so atrocious whoever programmed it needs to be executed. 
The gameplay consists of just running through small tunnels then big rooms, activating something, fighting a horde, rinse and repeat.
Each mission takes about 15-20 minutes and there are only 15 of them including the DLC...
There are no boss fights except for the final mission of the DLC.
The story is decent with lots of ties to Prometheus and Covenant of all movies lol. And you can get lots of lore drops from finding intel and then talking to NPCS.
The music is good, and the sound design is alright. Though, the weapons sound too muffled compared to other alien games.
The graphics are good and detailed, and the game runs well overall. Although my coop partner would ocassionally get disconnected during levels which was frustrating cause that means starting all over. There are also no checkpoints in missions and if everyone dies then its back to the beginning...
Things are hinted at for a sequel, and with actual story and cutscenes, more gameplay variety, and 4 player coop instead of 3, it could be good.
Overall for me as it stands this is just an ok 6/10. A good first attempt for a new studio with a big ip though. 
[spoiler] I enjoyed Colonial Marines more lol [/spoiler]

I can't fully recommend this game NOW. It's missing very basic features now because it's bugged (ex. you can't swap out accessories, or even upgraded gear.) It was a lot of fun when it came out and is still worth the sales prices.
If you love the Alien universe this game takes you on all the iconic backdrops and great shooter!

Not fun due to difficulty and that you have to restart from the beginning of the checkpoint. At the end of mission 2, an insane amount of enemies spawn in that just overwhelm you no matter how many you kill. Would not recommend, not fun, just plain frustrating.
